parallel.task: Plan the implementation including architecture decisions, test outline, and edge cases. Output as structured summary.
Review the plan for potential issues, inconsistencies, or missed requirements. Output as review document.

chain.task: Implement based on the plan from {outputs.plan} and incorporate feedback from {outputs.review}. Remember to git add -A && git commit on your branch before finishing.

parallel.task: Review the implementation diff for correctness, performance, and adherence to the plan. Output as validation report.
Check for edge cases, error handling, and test coverage gaps. Output as correctness report.

notes: This is the preferred shape: planners in parallel (cheap), single writer (sole writer), validators in fresh context (parallel, read-only). Adjust concurrency based on your tier (see ORCHESTRATION-BRIDGE.md).
